title: Lisbon-based Bizay, a customized products marketplace for SMBs, raised a $55M Series D led by Indico, as it aims to accelerate its US expansion (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
summary: Tamara Djurickovic / Tech.eu: Lisbon-based Bizay, a customized products marketplace for SMBs, raised a $55M Series D led by Indico, as it aims to accelerate its US expansion — BIZAY will use the fresh funding to accelerate its expansion in the US, pursue acquisitions in the customised products market and further develop AI infrastructure across its platform.
